dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: I'd love to have found more useful treasure, but our present gains will fuel my research for a time.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, Ms. Tahmures said that we shouldn't make too much of a fuss when the Akademiya folks show up, since we did leave early without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Seems like research and tournaments both favor those who are prepared to start at any time.
